decomposition_notes: Spec deviations recorded at /sdd-task time (2026-11-11), each detailed in the owning task: (1) ABAC actions must be object:verb - ActionKey splits on ':' and a bare 'read' raises (abac/policies/abstract.py:28), so the admin path would fail closed; names fixed in TASK-150. (2) UserGroupManager is also mounted at /api/v1/usergroups (handlers/__init__.py:35). (3) On the ModelView base PUT creates and POST needs a PK (400 otherwise), so user creation is PUT and the required_by_* lists follow the verbs (TASK-153). (4) The handlers/model.py base writes through post and delete as well as put/patch (TASK-155). (5) User decision: GET/HEAD are gated too on all five handlers. (6) Installed navigator-api 3.2.2 interpolates _filter into SQL; overridden in TASK-151. (7) The §1 probe script no longer exists; TASK-157 rebuilds it. (8) The role route must be registered before UserManager.configure (TASK-156). No Delegation Contracts: the parrot-targeted-writer MCP server is not configured in this repo.
